summary: Remove private website host addresses from docs and remap private HTTP update repos without naming a specific lab IP.

guide.reason: Operator guide already uses the public domain; this only removes private host addresses from plans/QA/API wording and internal remap logic.

api.reason: docs/API.md no longer names interim private repo URLs; behavior still remaps private HTTP repos to the public default.

verification.method: Repository search finds no private website host address; go test ./internal/nexupdate -run TestNormalize; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --all.
